messages:
Maria: quick sync after GA -> we've got two issues reported: embeddings producing wrong reranks for some queries, and occasional chat UI crash on very long sessions. Do we hotfix both or only embeddings? @alex @sam
Alex: embeddings look like an 8-bit quantization rounding edge case in the embed pipeline. Small code change + unit added, ~half day. I'd do embeddings hotfix now.
Sam: agree. Embedding rerank affects relevancy for paying customers (P1). UI crash seems browser memory guardrail related, intermittent; put in a mini-epic.
June: CS confirms two paying customers saw wrong reranks; this is impacting search relevance. Strong preference for hotfix to minimize revenue impact.
Oliver: crash repro so far: >5k token chat sessions trigger client OOM on certain browsers. Needs deterministic repro and design QA; low frequency.
Sophie: temporary mitigation: Console users can pin model variant `rr-open-embed-v1`. I'll send CSM steps and open tickets.
Maria: proposal: cut hotfix for embeddings tonight; create "chat-stability-v1" mini-epic for the UI crash with repro, staging 48h stability, and no token handling regressions as acceptance criteria.
Alex: will branch `release/1.2.1-hotfix-embed`, add fix + tests. Can we run a short night canary?
deploy-bot: started canary for release/1.2.1-hotfix-embed at 2024-11-02T03:12:00Z
Sam: I'll create mini-epic ticket, attach repro snippets, assign to @oliver and runtime eng. Target milestone: sprint end Nov 10.
Maria: timeline recap: hotfix cut tonight, canary -> promote tomorrow AM if green. Mini-epic doc to product/epics, tag me.
Sophie: notifying affected customers and adding rollback playbook.
Alex: canary looks clean so far; requesting promote in ~20m.
deploy-bot: canary completed, 0 errors in 10m monitoring window
Maria: approved for promote if monitoring stays green. We'll do an RCA after promote and then groom follow-on scope for chat-stability-v1. Tagging @june @oliver @sam
summary: Decision: immediate hotfix for embedding rerank regression; UI chat crash queued into a mini-epic 'chat-stability-v1' for next sprint. Support to notify customers and provide variant workaround. Hotfix branch cut and canaried.
